limitations: Skill Capsule destinations outside native ability IDs 1–77 are blocked without consumption; complete expanded ability effects are not implemented.
PP restoratives during Transform are blocked until switching out.
Crafting/case/Tera and selected named-item roles are labeled NXT adaptations, not complete original minigames or later-generation parity.
Native Windows/Edge and live MySQL deployment acceptance are not established by these tests.
